snippet.title: Mafia: The Old Country - “Whatever it Takes” Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
MAFIA: THE OLD COUNTRY launches AUGUST 8.

► Pre-order now: http://2kgam.es/Mafia
► Watch our Developer Insights video now: https://youtu.be/lVhXaoX25AE
► Watch our PAX East Developer Presentation, "Family Takes Sacrifice" - https://youtube.com/live/tmeirFVVzCA

Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily.

Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Cosa Nostra in this immersive third-person action-adventure.
